# Testing Luxor 

```{julia}
#| label: fig-circles
#| fig-cap: "Drawing an epitrochoid marked with circles."
#| fig-alt: "An epitrochoid drawn with circles"
#| code-fold: true

using Luxor, Colors
d = Drawing(800, 500, :svg)
origin()
rotate(pi/2)
p = epitrochoid(120, 12, 48, vertices=true)
L = 300
ps = polysample(p, L)
for (n, pt) in enumerate(ps)
    sethue(HSB(rescale(n, 1, L, 0, 360), 0.7, 0.6))
    circle(pt, 20sin(rescale(n, 1, L, 0, pi)), :fillpreserve)
    sethue("black")
    strokepath()
end
finish()
display(d)
```
